title: A clearer Windows experience.
summary: Simpler setup, complete allowance details and a steadier compact monitor.

sections.title: Getting started
items: A clean setup with the Llumi icon and simpler provider instructions.
Setup always uses Light. Existing preferences move to Light once; your later appearance choices stay saved.
Turn Codex and Claude Code monitoring on or off during setup and in Settings.

sections.title: Usage and allowances
items: See every supported allowance, with clear labels, remaining percentages and reset times when reported.
Sign-in readiness is separate from missing, unsupported, unavailable and stale allowance readings.
Retry respects provider limits, with longer waits after repeated rate-limit responses.

sections.title: Your monitor
items: Drag without triggering hover expansion, with a movement threshold that follows display scaling.
Keep a stable position when expanding details or changing displays. Reset Position returns it to its default location.
Expanded details include provider names and observation age. Open Usage shows additional limits when space is limited.

sections.title: About Llumi
items: Find the installed version and read its release notes inside Llumi, even offline.
Open Microsoft Store from About. Windows updates continue to be managed by Microsoft Store.

notice: Unreleased local preview. Microsoft Store publication is pending owner approval.
